Definition: of uncertain derivation; Bithynia, a region of Asia:--Bithynia.
BiblicalUsage: Bithynia is a region in the north of Asia Minor, and it is named twice, once by a closed door and once by an open letter. In Acts 16:7 Paul and his company assayed to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit suffered them not. In 1 Peter 1:1 Peter writes to the strangers scattered through Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia — the same region, now full of believers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bithynia is the proof that a closed door is not a closed future: the Spirit said no to Paul, and the gospel still reached Bithynia.
